privacyExport.sourceHeading: g) Where the data comes from
privacyExport.source: The data comes from you (checkout, forms, emails). Payment providers report the payment status, the carrier reports the delivery status.
privacyExport.automated: I do not make automated decisions or create profiles. For payments, Stripe runs an automated fraud and risk check as an independent controller; Stripe provides information about it.
privacyExport.notesHint: Internal notes that may also concern other people are not included in the file. I reviewed them before sending; anything that concerns you is in my reply.

process.intro: From the first word to healed skin. There is no online booking – everything begins with an email.

1.title: Request
1.text: Email me: your idea or the flash number, placement, rough size.

2.title: Appointment
2.text: We find a date. You'll get the exact address with the confirmation.

3.title: Deposit
3.text: We sort that out personally by email, not on this website.

4.title: Tattooing
4.text: Bring your ID, come well rested and with something in your stomach.

5.title: Aftercare
5.text: You'll get the aftercare steps to take home, and everything's on the aftercare page too.

aftercare.intro: Skin does not forget, but it needs time. A fresh tattoo is a small wound; these steps keep it company while it heals. If you are unsure, write to me.
aftercare.emptyText: I'll give you the aftercare steps at your appointment. If you have questions, just message me.
aftercare.warnHeading: Warning signs – when to see a doctor?
aftercare.warnText: If the redness keeps spreading after three days, the area gets hot or very swollen, pus comes out, red streaks appear or you get a fever. Please let me know afterwards, too.
aftercare.saferLink: Safer Tattoo checklists by the German Environment Ministry

commission.lead: A cap where your dog lives. A plate with a sentence only the two of you understand. A picture for someone you like. Tell me about it – I will paint it.

1.title: Request
1.text: Use the form to tell me what you'd like: object, motif, timeframe.

2.text: I'll reply by email with a price and a rough timeframe.

4.text: I paint, send you a photo, and then your piece is on its way.
